title: TrainingRevision
description: An immutable, non-overwritable record of a single controlled training adjustment. Its `revision_id` is a content hash of the record with the `revision_id` field itself excluded (see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

revision_id.description: Computed content id, format 'sha256:<hex>'. EXCLUDED from the canonical hash preimage; treat as output only.

run_id.description: Identifier of the training run this revision belongs to.

parent_revision_id.description: Reference to the previous revision in the chain, format 'sha256:<hex>' (absent for the first revision).

reason.description: Why this adjustment was made, e.g. 'oom_recovery', 'throughput_tuning'.

input_metrics.description: Snapshot of the metrics that triggered/justified the adjustment.

decision_rule.description: Identifier of the rule/policy that produced the adjustment.

base_checkpoint_id.description: Reference to the checkpoint the revision resumes from, format 'sha256:<hex>' (optional).

state_retention.description: Which pieces of training state were retained across the revision.

scheduler.description: Whether the LR scheduler state was retained.

grad_scaler.description: Whether the gradient scaler state was retained.

canary_result.description: Outcome snapshot of the canary run that gated this revision (optional).

performance_delta.description: Measured performance change attributed to this revision (optional).

rolled_back.description: Whether this revision was ultimately rolled back.
